pages.text: Press $(k:key.puffish_skills.open) for your talent trees. Kills earn talent experience, shared with party members within 200 blocks.$(br2)Kills fill the class tree up to 18 points, each one slower than the last. The tree has more talents than that, so choose.
The weapon tree holds 10 points.$(br2)The great bosses give $(l)Ascension$() points instead, for a tab of their own: see $(l)Ascension and Fates$().
Changed your mind? An $(item)Orb of Oblivion$() resets your talents so you can spend them again, or on another class tree. It resets the Side Class tab too.
